units: <cite ref="Nazir 44a:3">Naz. 44</cite> <he>לאביו בזמן שהוא ש׳ וכ׳</he> ‘for his father’ (<cite ref="Leviticus 21:2">Lev. XXI, 2</cite>) as long as his body is intact (he may defile himself by contact), but not when it is defective.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 1:4">B. Kam. I, 4</cite>, a. fr. <he>נזק ש׳</he> (abbrev. <he>נ״ש</he>), v. <cite ref="N00461"><he>נֵזֶק</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 79:5">Gen. R. s. 79</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 33:18">Gen. XXXIII, 18</cite>) <he>ש׳ בגופו</he> intact in his body; <he>ש׳ בבניו</he> intact in his children; <he>ש׳ בממונו</he> unimpaired in his possessions; <he>ש׳ בתלמודו</he> whole in his learning (having forgotten nothing of his paternal lessons). Sifra Vayikra, N’dabah, Par. 13, ch. XVI (play on <cite ref="U01360"><he>שְׁלָמִים</he></cite>) <he>מי שחוא ש׳ מביא שלמים היה אונן וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="U01251"><he>שָׁלוֹם</he></cite>) if he is whole (mourns over no loss), he may bring a peace-offering, if he is a mourner, he dare not.
<cite ref="Genesis 33:18">Ib.</cite> <he>כל קרבן … היה ש׳ מביא וכ׳</he> whatever sacrifice he may offer, if he is whole, he may &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 5:3">Nidd. V, 3</cite> <he>כחתן ש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H01904"><he>חָתָן</he></cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 116b:1">B. Kam. 116ᵇ</cite> <he>נותן לו שכרו מִשָּׁ׳</he> he must pay him the full (promised) reward, opp. <he>אין לו אלא שכרו</he> he can claim only the ordinary wages for his labor.—Pl. <cite ref="U01360"><he>שְׁלֵמִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="U01327"><he>שְׁלֵמִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="U01326"><he>שְׁלֵי׳</he></cite>. Sifra l. c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 39b:3">Ber. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>פתיתין וש׳</he> broken pieces of bread and whole loaves.
Sabb. 98ᵇ ש׳ solid boards, opp. דנִיסְרָא; a. fr.—Fem. שְׁלֵמָה, שְׁלֵי׳.

<cite ref="Zevachim 5a:6">Zeb. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>משנה ש׳</he> a perfect (undisputed) Mishnah. Ber. l. c. <he>פרוסה של חיטין וש׳ וכ׳</he> if there is before you a piece of wheat bread, and a whole loaf of barley bread. Ib. <he>מניח … בתוך הש׳</he> he places the broken with the whole loaf. Ib. <he>וש׳ משנתך</he> (Ms. M. <he>ושלום</he>) and what thou teachest is perfect. Tosef. ib. IV, 15.

<cite ref="Menachot 65b:1">Men. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>ולא תהא תורה ש׳ שלנו וכ׳</he> should not our perfect Torah pass for as much as your idle talk?; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 2:4:3">Y. Pes. II, 29ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מצה שלמה</he>, v. <cite ref="U01356"><he>שְׁלֹמֹה</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>שְׁלֵמוֹת</he>, <cite ref="U01326"><he>שְׁלֵי׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tractate Semachot 8:16">Treat. S’maḥoth ch. VIII</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 27:6">Deut. XXVII, 6</cite>) <he>ומה אבנים … יהיו ש׳ לפני בני תורה … יהיו שלימים לפני הקב״ה וכ׳</he> of stones (for the altar) which do not see …, because they make peace between Israel and their father in heaven, the Lord says, they must be whole before me, how much more must scholars, I who are an atonement for the world, be whole before the Lord!; a. e.
